title: Villa del Sol: Heated Pool, B-Ball & Guest House
description:
🌞 Villa del Sol: Heated Pool, B-Ball & Guest House 🏡✨

Gated ¾-acre compound in South Tempe, perfect for family reunions, golf trips, or retreats. Sleeps 16 with 6BR/6BA including a detached guest house. Enjoy a massive heated 30,000-gal pool with grotto, half basketball court, putting green, billiards room, chef’s kitchen, BBQ patio, 4K TVs & gig WiFi.
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, saltwater
headline_features: Gated 3/4-acre private compound in quiet South Tempe enclave
Massive heated 30,000-gallon saltwater resort pool with rock waterfall grotto
Full private basketball half-court and putting green
Billiards room with championship pool table
Covered outdoor chef kitchen and BBQ pavilion with fire pit
Chef's kitchen with GE stainless steel appliances and 16-person dining
Ultra-fast 433+ Mbps gigabit WiFi and 4K smart TVs throughout
